blocks.title: Framework
blocks.text: In software engineering, a framework is a standardized and reusable set of concepts, practices and tools that provides a structured foundation for developing software applications.

A framework offers predefined components and architectures that make it easier to implement specific software functions, so developers can focus on writing code specific to their application rather than reinventing common solutions. Frameworks promote efficiency, consistency and code reusability, improving the overall quality and maintainability of software systems.

blocks.title: Example
blocks.text: To create a website, instead of writing all the code from scratch you can use a framework like Django. Django comes with ready-made features such as user login, database management and page templates, like using a pre-designed blueprint to build a house instead of designing everything yourself.
